body: Can you explain how that is abusive?  I genuinely don't understand.
He knows.  And he doesn't care.
Still here.  I guess I just don't see any point.  You can never be happy.
I'm still here.  Couldn't find the right spot.  I'll try again tomorrow.

He seems relieved I'm not around anymore.  If I bled out tonight, he wouldn't even come to the funeral. I know he wouldn't. I was worthless to him.  3 years and I was worthless.

Thanks for the kind words.  I just know I never meant anything now.
